<style>
  :root {
    --rule-soft: rgba(197,201,197,0.08);
  }

  /* Hide default quarto title block */
  #title-block-header { display: none; }

  .stage-404 {
    min-height: calc(100vh - 68px);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 80px 40px 120px;
    position: relative;
  }

  /* letterpress card */
  .err-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 960px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.35fr 1fr;
    gap: 56px;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    padding: 28px 0;
  }

  /* corner ornaments */
  .err-corner {
    position: absolute;
    font-family: var(--f-mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    color: var(--fg-faint);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .err-corner.tl { top: -32px; left: 0; }
  .err-corner.tr { top: -32px; right: 0; text-align: right; }
  .err-corner.bl { bottom: -36px; left: 0; }
  .err-corner.br { bottom: -36px; right: 0; text-align: right; }

  /* the chart frame */
  .err-chart-frame {
    border: 1px solid var(--rule);
    background: var(--d-ink-0);
    padding: 14px 18px 18px;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  }
  .err-chart-head {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    font-family: var(--f-mono);
    font-size: 10.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--fg-faint);
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft);
  }
  .err-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; }

  /* marginalia hand-note */
  .err-margin-note {
    position: absolute;
    font-family: var(--f-hand);
    color: var(--d-orange);
    line-height: 1.1;
    transform: rotate(-4deg);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 3;
  }
  .err-arrow {
    position: absolute;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  /* fade-in keyframes */
  @keyframes err-fade-up {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  .err-f1 { opacity: 0; animation: err-fade-up 0.7s var(--ease) 4.2s forwards; }
  .err-f2 { opacity: 0; animation: err-fade-up 0.7s var(--ease) 4.4s forwards; }
  .err-f3 { opacity: 0; animation: err-fade-up 0.7s var(--ease) 4.7s forwards; }
  .err-f4 { opacity: 0; animation: err-fade-up 0.7s var(--ease) 5.0s forwards; }
  .err-f5 { opacity: 0; animation: err-fade-up 0.7s var(--ease) 5.3s forwards; }

  /* Back button */
  .err-back-btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--d-orange);
    padding: 12px 22px;
    color: var(--d-orange) !important;
    font-family: var(--f-display);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-style: italic;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
  }
  .err-back-btn:hover {
    background: var(--d-orange);
    color: var(--d-ink-0) !important;
  }
  .err-back-btn .err-arrow-g {
    font-family: var(--f-hand);
    font-size: 22px;
    line-height: 0.8;
  }

  .err-quiet-link {
    font-family: var(--f-serif);
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--d-aqua) !important;
    text-decoration: underline !important;
    text-decoration-color: rgba(142,164,162,0.35) !important;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
  }
  .err-quiet-link:hover { color: var(--d-paper) !important; }

  .err-kicker {
    font-family: var(--f-mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    color: var(--d-red);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .err-headline {
    font-family: var(--f-display);
    font-size: clamp(56px, 7vw, 96px);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 0.92;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    color: var(--fg);
    margin: 0 0 18px;
    font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 144, 'SOFT' 80;
  }
  .err-headline em {
    font-family: var(--f-display);
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--d-orange);
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  .err-lede {
    font-family: var(--f-serif);
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 22px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    color: var(--d-old-white);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    max-width: 480px;
  }
  .err-lede code {
    font-style: normal;
    font-family: var(--f-mono);
    color: var(--d-yellow);
    background: rgba(196,178,138,0.08);
    padding: 0.1em 0.4em;
    border: 1px solid rgba(196,178,138,0.18);
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-size: 0.9em;
  }

  .err-body {
    font-family: var(--f-serif);
    font-size: 15.5px;
    line-height: 1.68;
    color: var(--fg-dim);
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    max-width: 440px;
  }

  .err-inline-code {
    font-family: var(--f-mono);
    color: var(--d-yellow);
    background: rgba(196,178,138,0.08);
    padding: 0.1em 0.4em;
    border: 1px solid rgba(196,178,138,0.18);
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-size: 0.9em;
  }

  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .err-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
    .stage-404 { padding: 60px 24px 100px; }
    .err-corner.tr, .err-corner.br { text-align: left; right: auto; left: 0; }
  }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  const path = document.getElementById('err-divpath');
  const main = document.getElementById('err-dmain');
  const glow = document.getElementById('err-dglow');
  const dot  = document.getElementById('err-tipdot');
  const lbl  = document.getElementById('err-tip404');
  const lblG = document.getElementById('err-tip404-glow');
  if (!path || !main || !glow) return;
  const total = path.getTotalLength();
  const dur = 3800;

  [main, glow].forEach(el => {
    el.style.strokeDasharray = total;
    el.style.strokeDashoffset = total;
  });

  let t0 = null;
  function ease(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }

  function frame(ts) {
    if (!t0) t0 = ts;
    const raw = Math.min((ts - t0) / dur, 1);
    const t = ease(raw);
    const drawn = t * total;

    main.style.strokeDashoffset = total - drawn;
    glow.style.strokeDashoffset = total - drawn;

    const p = path.getPointAtLength(drawn);
    dot.setAttribute('cx', p.x);
    dot.setAttribute('cy', p.y);
    lbl.setAttribute('x', p.x + 24);
    lbl.setAttribute('y', p.y - 12);
    lblG.setAttribute('x', p.x + 24);
    lblG.setAttribute('y', p.y - 12);

    if (raw < 1) {
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    } else {
      dot.animate([
        { r: 4.5, opacity: 1 },
        { r: 8,   opacity: 0.4 },
        { r: 4.5, opacity: 1 },
      ], { duration: 1800, iterations: Infinity, easing: 'ease-in-out' });
    }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
